# Heartbeat of South Bay

> Managed lead-response and business systems for service businesses, with structured inquiry handling, approved follow-up workflows, handoff, and pipeline visibility.

Heartbeat of South Bay designs, implements, and manages practical systems that help service businesses improve how inquiries are handled after they arrive. Standard public pricing for the AI Lead Conversion System is $997 one-time implementation and $1,497/month ongoing system management. Exact scope is confirmed before implementation. AI voice is not standard inclusion and is separately scoped.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of managed lead response and practical business systems.
- [AI Lead Conversion System](/leads): The primary managed offer for one business location, with exact scope confirmed before build.
- [Business Impact Scenario Calculator](/roi): A user-controlled estimation tool, not a forecast, guarantee, or promise of performance.
- [Free AI Revenue System Assessment](/assessment): Focused questions, initial findings, and an optional review. Complimentary, with no purchase commitment.
- [About Heartbeat of South Bay](/about): Process-first approach, founder story, and credentials.
- [Articles](/blog): Insights on lead conversion, business systems, and practical AI.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact Heartbeat of South Bay by message, phone, or email.
